summary: Uxin Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 2, 2026, announcing a joint venture agreement with Hebei Chengying Investment Promotion Operation Co., Ltd. to establish Uxin (Shijiazhuang) Automobile Maintenance Co., Ltd. Uxin Anhui will contribute RMB30.0 million (75%) and Hebei Chengying will contribute RMB10.0 million (25%) to the joint venture's registered capital. The joint venture aims to support a new used car superstore in Shijiazhuang. This is a strategic partnership with a state-owned enterprise, not a special situation. No price per share, premium, or deal close date is stated. The filing is a routine business development disclosure, not a transformative corporate event.
